description: Webhook for the Lark content bot at /webhook/lark-content-strategy (event subscription and card callback URL). Answers Lark's URL check, acknowledges within Lark's 3 seconds, then hands button clicks to 'Strategy: handle action' and messages to 'Strategy: handle message'. Nothing from the request is trusted: handlers check the row token, your open_id, and re-read messages from the Lark API.
name: Strategy: lark events
